links.outcome: Length and text-complexity of AI-generated vs clinician-authored patient instructions
links.effect: AI instructions longer (median 1994 vs 482 characters) and scored higher on 3 text-complexity indices (all P < .001).
links.quote: AI instructions were longer than clinician-authored content (median 1994 vs 482 characters) and scored higher on 3 text-complexity indices (all P < .001).

links.outcome: Whether clinician editing of AI drafts reduces instruction complexity
links.effect: Clinician editing increased length without meaningfully reducing complexity; median character-level edit distance between AI drafts and final documentation 39.7%.
links.quote: Clinician editing of AI content increased length without meaningfully reducing complexity.
